description.text: Why NANCHANG HANGKONG UNIVERSIY?1.Situated in NANCHANG HANGKONG, a key modern city in the east area of China;2.Engineering oriented comprehensive university; one of the best universities that has the major of civil engineering in China;3.Pure English taught programs;4.Accommodation for international students equippedwith complete facilities;5.Good climate with mild four seasons;6.Convenient shopping environment.Teaching Objective:Cultivate professional talents with solid theoretical basis and strong practical ability, able to engage in project planning, design, R&D and management of civil engineering. Mainly learn the knowledge in the aspects of mechanics, civil engineering planning and model selection, engineering materials, foundation treatment, project management, and etc., and master basic skills in construction technology, engineering surveying, experiment and comprehensive application of computer and modern equipment for project design, construction and management.Curriculum:The undergraduate courses mainly include Theoretical Mechanics, Mechanics of Materials, Structural Mechanics, Architecture for Buildings, Soil Mechanics and Science,Foundation Engineering, Reinforced-concrete Structures,Steel Structures, Civil Engineering Construction, Bridge Engineering, Road Engineering,etc.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Nanchang Hangkong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Passport ;2.Application form ;3.High school transcripts ;4.High school graduation certificate;5.Self-introduction video ( 3-5 minutes ):Self-introduction (age, family background, education background, personality, hobbies)Why do you choose to study this major ?Why do you choose to study in Nanchang Hangkong University ?How do you spend your four years in China ?Documents needed for applying for JW202 form:6.two inch photo (photo of passport);7.physical examination form;8.non-criminal record;9.Proof of bank deposit.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health.2. Education background and age limit:Applicants for undergraduate program must have senior high school diploma with good academic performance and be under the age of 22.3.Obey the relevant laws of the PRC and meet the admission requirements of the host universities.4. Applicants must have a good academic record and merits.
